purpose: Prepare real package-manager reference and acceptance transactions without guessing durability semantics or mutating the pinned base image.

image_policy.base: verified pinned Debian qcow2 from docs/debian13/arm64-target.json

package_selection.rule: Do not call the transaction corpus PREP_READY until exact package version, architecture and repository object/hash are recorded.

failure_injection.goal: Document actual selected-filesystem guarantee; never claim stronger atomicity than provided.
Measure reference behavior and selected-filesystem durability boundary.
Second package-manager process must observe reference-compatible lock failure/wait behavior.
Failure must not turn into silent package database success.

runtime_owner_rules: file/advisory locks attach to canonical OFD/process identities
durability calls report only guarantees the selected persistent filesystem actually provides
Step-30 exec and Step-31 interpreter/shebang paths are reused
network/time/entropy come from accepted canonical owners
